reference_ld: 1000 Genomes phase 3 EUR503; zero cross-chromosome LD as previously constructed
caveats: Exploratory postselected weighted marginal Z, not individual-level prediction or calibration.
UK Biobank overlaps score discovery; low grip strength is a component of physical frailty, not FI or FFS.
Reference LD approximates null Z correlation, requiring compatible study samples, effects and errors; per-variant sample and heterogeneity may differ across cohorts.
Hardy-Weinberg genotype standard deviation uses target effect-allele frequency; score weights and FFS orientation remain research prototypes.
